{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT – Create a premium static landing page for “Maison Molar Academy”, an online dental education brand teaching dentists, hygienists, and dental students modern clinical skills. Build it as a polished React + Tailwind static site only, no backend, no login, no database, no payments, no real API, no external live data. All course cards, testimonials, stats, schedules, instructor info, and pricing can be mock/sample content written directly in the page. Overall vibe: Art Deco luxury meets modern SaaS clarity, inspired by Linear’s clean spacing, sharp typography, smooth sections, subtle gradients, refined cards, and elegant motion feel, but with a dental education identity. WEBSITE TYPE: landing page / marketing site. LANGUAGE: English. STYLE: premium art-deco, clinical but warm, ivory + deep emerald + champagne gold + charcoal, geometric borders, thin gold dividers, fan motifs, stepped shapes, subtle tooth enamel patterns, soft glows, glass panels, lots of whitespace. IMPORTANT: must include a sticky navigation bar that stays at top while scrolling, with anchor links that jump to sections: Home, Curriculum, Instructors, Outcomes, Pricing, FAQ. Nav should look elegant, semi-transparent, blurred background, gold bottom line, responsive mobile menu or clean mobile layout. HERO SECTION: badge “Dental CE • Clinical Mastery • 2026 Cohort”, large headline like “Elevate Your Dental Practice With Artful, Evidence-Based Education”, subheading explaining hands-on style training for restorative dentistry, occlusion, cosmetic planning, patient communication, and practice confidence. CTA buttons: “Explore Curriculum” and “View Sample Lessons”. Add right-side premium dashboard mockup card, not a real app, showing static lesson progress, enamel shade guide, upcoming workshop, skill score, and completion rings made with CSS/Tailwind. Add decorative art deco frame around it. TRUST STRIP: static logos/text for mock dental schools and clinics, e.g. Northbridge Dental Institute, Aurelia Smile Studio, Crown & Canal Society, etc. STATS: 12 modules, 48 micro-lessons, 6 case walkthroughs, 96% learner satisfaction, clearly mock/static. PROBLEM/SOLUTION SECTION: explain that many dentists know the theory but need visual frameworks, chairside workflows, and repeatable treatment planning. Use 3 elegant cards: Diagnose with Clarity, Plan with Confidence, Communicate Beautifully. CURRICULUM SECTION: complex detailed grid of course modules. Include 8 cards with icons or simple line illustrations: 1 Foundations of Esthetic Dentistry, 2 Occlusion Without Overwhelm, 3 Composite Layering Lab, 4 Smile Design Principles, 5 Photography & Case Documentation, 6 Treatment Planning Conversations, 7 Indirect Restorations Workflow, 8 Maintenance & Long-Term Success. Each card has duration, level, what you learn bullets, and art deco number label. FEATURE SECTION: “Built Like a Modern Learning Atelier” with Linear-inspired product blocks: clean dark panel, segmented tabs visual (static only), lesson timeline, case library preview, downloadable checklist mockups, no real downloads needed. OUTCOMES SECTION: before/after style content but do NOT need real images; use elegant placeholder panels or gradient cards labeled Case A / Case B, showing improvements such as shade selection, margin design, patient consent clarity. INSTRUCTORS SECTION: create 3 fictional instructors with credentials, portraits can be initials/avatar placeholders, e.g. Dr. Celeste Moreno DDS, Dr. Arun Vale BDS MSc, Hygienist Mara Quinn RDH. Make cards classy with gold outlines and specialty tags. TESTIMONIALS: include 5 realistic mock testimonials from dentists/students, with star ratings and short quotes. SCHEDULE SECTION: static 2026 cohort timeline with modules by month, in a vertical art deco timeline: Orientation, Core Clinical Frameworks, Case Review Week, Advanced Esthetics, Capstone Presentation. PRICING SECTION: static pricing cards, no payment integration. Plans: Essentials, Atelier, Clinic Team. Include price placeholders like $149, $349, $899, feature lists, one highlighted “Most Popular”. Buttons should say “Choose Plan” but not actually connect anywhere, just anchor or visual. FAQ SECTION: accordion style can be static/open layout or simple client-side interaction only, questions about who it is for, CE credits disclaimer, materials, time commitment, whether beginners can join. Add clear note: “Static demo content – no enrollment processing included.” FOOTER: rich footer with mini brand mark, newsletter mock input (visual only, no submission/backend), links, social placeholders, copyright 2026. RESPONSIVENESS: must look excellent on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Use Tailwind utilities, clean component structure, no external services required. INTERACTIONS: sticky nav, smooth anchor scrolling, hover states on cards/buttons, subtle fade/slide CSS animations if simple, maybe mobile nav toggle is okay because it is front-end only. Do not implement authentication, admin panels, dashboards with real functionality, database, server routes, or API calls. IMAGE REQUIREMENTS: avoid relying on external images; use CSS gradients, SVG-like decorative shapes, icons, initials, and placeholders. DETAIL LEVEL: make it feel like a complete premium landing page with many sections, not a small template. The final result should feel like an art-deco dental education academy website that could sell a high-end continuing education program, with Linear-like precision and polish, built completely as a static React + Tailwind page.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
